item.title: OCaml Weekly News, 10 Nov 2026
item.description:
1. neocaml 0.11
  2. OSEC-2026-30: OCaml runtime "ephemeron data is freed while still referenced"
  3. OSEC-2026-28: github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read via path traversal in ~/conferences/ocaml/**~
  4. OCaml 4.14.5 released
  5. rocq-typescript-extraction (experimental): Extract Rocq definitions to TypeScript ES modules
  6. Bisect_ppx, the coverage tool, moving to ocaml-ppx
  7. Blog post: From AST to CST
  8. Senior OCaml Engineer / Tech Lead – Elpe Open-Source Tool (SuperSafe Project) at OCamlPro
  9. Release of Alcotest 1.10 and dune-release 2.3
